name: hcapp_listPasskeys
description: Every passkey registered against the calling hasher (E9.F7.S18). A passkey is a credential on an HC.Device row, so this lists the user's live devices (removed = 0) that hold a PasskeyCredentialId. Read-only. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 119, @param NULL); @userId comes from the token and the WHERE is scoped to it. The credential id and public key never leave the server. Kept deployed and unchanged for builds 1390/1391; new clients use hcapp_listDevices, of which this is a subset.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL. Also used to flag IsThisDevice.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail alone and the SP returns.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: emitted before the query runs.

rowsets.name: Passkeys
rowsets.description: One row per passkey-bearing live device, newest sign-in first. WHERE d.UserId = @userId AND d.removed = 0 AND d.PasskeyCredentialId IS NOT NULL.

columns.name: Label
columns.description: 'Safari on iPhone', 'Harrier Central on iPhone' — from Device.OperatingSystem / IsMobile and HC6.DevicePlatformName(DeviceData).

columns.name: IsThisDevice
columns.description: 1 when the row is the calling @deviceId.

sideEffects: None on success. INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error.

codeSmells.issue: Success envelope emitted before the query
codeSmells.detail: Line 53 sends {success:1} before the SELECT at line 55; a query failure is logged and re-thrown after the envelope has gone out.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
